tools.name: add_target

tools.name: start_sequence
tools.description: Starts the advanced sequence that is loaded (load_sequence) or built (add_target) and returns as soon as it runs; it then runs on its own for hours, moving the mount, camera, focuser and guider. tools.name: run_autofocus

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

tools.name: add_target

tools.name: capture_image

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 100). Default 0.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 100). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 100). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 100). Default 0.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 100). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: start_sequence
tools.description: Starts the advanced sequence that is loaded (load_sequence) or built (add_target) and returns as soon as it runs; it then runs on its own for hours, moving the mount, camera, focuser and guider. While it runs, other hardware and change tools are refused unless force is passed. Monitor with get_status, get_sequence and get_recent_images; stop with stop_sequence (or stop_all). Finished items are skipped on a new start: reset_sequence first to run everything again.

skip_validation.description: Start even when NINA's sequence validation reports issues. Default false.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. tools.name: run_autofocus
tools.description: Runs NINA's autofocus routine with the profile's autofocus settings on the current filter (change_filter first to focus on another filter): takes a series of exposures at several focuser positions, fits the HFR curve and moves to the best position. Needs a connected camera and focuser and stars in the field (the mount should track a star field). Takes one to several minutes, so it usually returns a running job: poll get_job. outcome.data holds the final position, HFR, filter and temperature. The job holds the 'camera' resource (autofocus uses camera and focuser) and is refused while a focuser job runs.

tools.name: capture_image
tools.description: Takes one exposure with the imaging camera (changing the filter first when 'filter' is set) and returns its statistics in outcome.data (HFR in pixels, star count, mean/median ADU, file path when saved). Use it for test frames: framing, focus check, exposure check. By default the frame is analysed but not saved; save: true writes it like a normal LIGHT frame. Omitted gain/offset/binning keep the camera's current settings. Runs as a background job holding the camera; the default wait covers short exposures, poll get_job for long ones. For many frames build a sequence with add_target instead.

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel (see get_status), e.g. "Ha" or "L". Omit to keep the current filter.

gain.description: Camera gain (driver units). Omit to keep the current gain.

offset.description: Camera offset (driver units). Omit to keep the current offset.

binning.description: Symmetric binning factor (1-4; 2 = 2x2). Omit to keep the current binning.

save.description: Save the frame to disk as a LIGHT frame. Default false (snapshot, analysed only).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-120, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 100). Default 0.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. tools.name: move_focuser
tools.description: Moves the focuser to an absolute position in steps (see the current position in get_status). Runs as a background job holding the focuser; refused while a camera job (capture or autofocus) runs, because moving focus would spoil it. Prefer run_autofocus for finding focus; use this to return to a known good position.

tools.name: run_autofocus
tools.description: Runs NINA's autofocus routine with the profile's autofocus settings on the current filter (change_filter first to focus on another filter): takes a series of exposures at several focuser positions, fits the HFR curve and moves to the best position. Needs a connected camera and focuser and stars in the field (the mount should track a star field). Takes one to several minutes, so it usually returns a running job: poll get_job. outcome.data holds the final position, HFR, filter and temperature. The job holds the 'camera' resource (autofocus uses camera and focuser) and is refused while a focuser job runs.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 100). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.
